$comment: Fake deployment scenario for the over-speed acceptance of the two-process
application: the joint velocity limit is exceeded before the runtime has
even finished booting, so the execution state machine latches
JointVelocityExceeded instead of entering ZeroTorque, and the upper
application reports the lower fault in step. Mirrors the runtime CLI
test's own fault.json (dq 15.0 against the configured
runtime.safety.joint_velocity_limits of 10.0) as a shipped scenario, so the
unit-limit path is covered at the process level too.
The write path stays accepted: the fault is the measured velocity, never a
refused torque, which is what distinguishes this case from
elapsed_us is monotonic from process start; an entry applies from its time
onwards. One entry is enough: the latch is checked on the first tick.
